definitions.explanation: The act of washing clothes or other fabric items. Also refers to the clothes themselves that need to be washed or have been washed.

examples.japanese: {洗濯|せんたく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{天気|てんき}→天気：00582_tenki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{洗濯|せんたく}{物|もの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{干|ほ}そう→干す：00115_hosu⟧。
examples.english: The weather is nice, so let's hang the laundry outside to dry.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧⟦{洗濯機|せんたくき}→洗濯機：04969_sentakuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回|まわ}して→回す：01158_mawasu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: Every morning I run the washing machine before going to work.

notes:
USAGE:
One of the most common household vocabulary words. Used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ to form the verb "to do laundry" ({洗濯|せんたく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧). The kanji {濯|たく} is rarely seen outside this word.

Be careful not to confuse with the homophone ⟦{選択|せんたく}→選択：03306_sentaku⟧ (selection, choice), which uses different kanji.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {洗濯|せんたく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to do laundry
- {洗濯|せんたく}{物|もの}: laundry (items to be washed or drying)
- ⟦{洗濯機|せんたくき}→洗濯機：04969_sentakuki⟧: washing machine
- {洗濯|せんたく}{物|もの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{干|ほ}す→干す：00115_hosu⟧: to hang laundry to dry
- {洗濯|せんたく}{物|もの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{込|こ}む→取り込む：05871_torikomu⟧: to bring in the laundry
